nameOrigin.text: The Town says the name comes from the Dominguez-Escalante Expedition of 1776, though the reason for it is unclear.

founded.text: The Town was founded in 1894; cattle ranchers had been settling the Mancos Valley since the 1870s.

timeline.text: The Dominguez-Escalante Expedition, which the Town credits for the name Mancos.
The Town of Mancos was founded.
The first Mancos Days celebration took place in Boyle Park.
